item.title: Two Iranian men charged over alleged terror plot targeting Manchester’s Jewish community
item.description: Man, most likely in Iran, was in contact with men arrested on the eve of Yom Kippur, police say Two Iranian men have been charged in relation to an alleged terror plot targeting Manchester’s Jewish community. ​Police say another man, most likely in Iran, was in contact with them as part of a plot to get a bomb to attack Jewish targets.
